name: MineMenu
description: A fun menu with 80+ hacks for your own worlds (and, since 5.0, by command on servers where you are OP) on 7 pages (Player, Combat, World, Items, Build, Fun, Utility): fly, noclip, freecam, morph, copy/paste and schematics, item/potion/mob creators, chaos mode, minimap, waypoints... with search, favorites, keys for any hack and a Command Palette (Ctrl+K). Right Shift in your own world. In English and Portuguese (Portugal).
